title: Supreme Court: National Park Service v. National Trust for Historic Preservation in the United States
summary: Because the government has established that it is likely to prevail in showing that the Trust lacks Article III standing to challenge the East Wing project in federal court, that it would likely suffer irreparable harm without a stay, and that the balance of equities tips in its favor, the injunction entered by the District Court is stayed pending the disposition of the government’s forthcoming petition for a writ of certiorari, if such writ is timely sought. (No. 26A203, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 609/2).

title: Supreme Court: Trump v. California
summary: The Government’s application to stay the District Court’s injunction in 26A124—which forbids the Government to implement §§2 and 3 of Executive Order No. 14399—is granted; the application for a stay in 26A139 is denied as moot. (No. 26A124, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 609/2).
